name: Libreria World refresh
description: Make parts of a world anew without touching the bases: a map of every chunk (what stays: claims, where people spent time, what you pick; what goes), per world. At the next restart the rest is wiped and comes back fresh when someone goes there, with its structures in new places (strongholds stay). Operators only; server-side with the server's resource pack; requires Libreria (core).
